name: Alabama

flag.description: A white field with a crimson saltire (diagonal cross) running from corner to corner.
flag.symbolism: The law gives no meaning for the design; the crimson cross is often said to recall the saltire of the Confederate battle flag.

hook: Alabama is a bare red X on white with nothing in the middle; put a seal at the crossing and you have Florida.
trivia: The 1895 law says the bars of the cross must be at least six inches wide.
With no seal, words or stars, it is one of the plainest US state flags.
